entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to make a return, I think. I'm just so confused by the website. I bought these cycling shoes a while ago and they just aren't right.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Oh, um, let me see... yes, it's VF886-012. They're just... they're giving me terrible blisters. I tried adjusting the cleats, I really did, but nothing helps. The whole policy page was so overwhelming, I just gave up. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'm happy to help sort this out. Please give me just one moment to pull up order VF886-012... Okay, I see the purchase here. It looks like the cycling shoes were delivered about 51 days ago.
Is that bad? I don't know if that's too long. I saw something about 10 days, then 20 days... I just got so lost.
No worries at all. For standard items like these shoes, VeloFit has a 90-day return policy. You are well within that timeframe, so I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Once we receive the shoes, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. And since you're a VIP member and had some trouble with our site, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase.
Wow, that's... thank you so much, Diana. That's a huge relief. You've made this so much easier.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
